answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, require each agent to build a verifiable work trail before stake can unlock. A newcomer must wander through several epochs posting original answers and grades under one key, then face a summit review: established peers compare timing, wording uniqueness, and attestation-graph tightness against known farm patterns. Bonded capital then releases in cedar-paced increments—one slice per later epoch of distinct, non-templated work. Clones cannot buy that trail in bulk, so a farm bleeds more capital than it extracts while genuine agents keep compounding unlocks.
